Jordan: quick FYI — main CI turned red right after merge of #4873 (tiny proto field rename). Failing in smoke_gpu_alloc step on multiple shards. Anyone grabbing this?
CI Bot: pipeline status: FAILED at step 'smoke_gpu_alloc' (exit code 1) — job id: 4419876543-1. Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/4419876543
Jordan: logs show kvalloc OOM on shard 2/4, stack points to alloc_buffer alignment code. snippet: ```Allocation failed: requested 16384 bytes, available 8192
  at kv::alloc::aligned_alloc (+0x1f2)
  at serve::init_shard (+0x4a3)```
Priya: ack. pinging allocator owners. @Alex, you oncall for allocator? :eyes:
Alex: I can take a look. grabbing logs now. Did the merged PR touch any allocator headers?
Jordan: only a proto field rename and a tiny serialization guard. Weird that it affects alignment. I repro'ed locally with a quick smoke run — saw the same OOM on shard 2. Command I used: ```./dev/run-smoke --shards=4 --batch-size=1 --seed=42```
Alex: OK can you rerun with debug alloc flags? `EXPORT KV_DEBUG=1 ./dev/run-smoke ...` and attach profile. If reproducible, I can bisect.
Sam: I can kick a CI rerun with debug flags. Kicking now (will attach --collect-prof).
CI Bot: rerun triggered by Sam: job id 4419876560 (collect-prof enabled).
Priya: if bisect needed I can help triage the five commits in that PR. Also adding eng-sre in case infra nodes are flaky.
Alex: quick heads-up — if rerun stays flaky only on nvcluster-3, might be node drift. If it's deterministic across nodes, it's likely a code regression from the merge.
Sam: rerun results are in: 3/4 shards passed, shard nvcluster-3 still OOMs. Logs uploaded: https://ci.internal/jobs/4419876560/logs
Jordan: that points to node issue, but it reproduced locally too for me. Could be a timing + small memory bump triggering older nodes.
Alex: I'm starting a local bisect to peel commits off the PR — focusing on the proto rename -> serialization guard -> small mem pad change. Will update in a few mins.
Priya: thanks. If bisect narrows to a single commit, let's do a revert/fastpatch to main until we get a proper fix.
Alex: update: bisect points to the serialization guard tweak (commit abc123) as the likely trigger — it changes buffer padding in a way that can increase peak mem by ~8KB per shard. I'll open a revert PR shortly.
Sam: opening a revert PR now and will run CI once created. PR link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/revert-4873-abc123
CI Bot: new PR created (revert-4873-abc123) — CI queued.
Jordan: perfect. Thanks all. Priya — please coordinate patch cut if CI confirms green on revert.
Priya: on it. will monitor CI and ping when we can merge.
Alex: final note: we should add a tiny pressure test to smoke to catch similar padding regressions in future. Filed follow-up ticket: TKT-2334.
Jordan: :+1: closing loop here — will update incident board if revert goes in or if SRE finds node issues.
